name: Chandrayaan-2 Vikram (impact site)

outcomeDetail.summary: Descent-guidance failure: in the second descent phase 'the reduction in velocity was more than the designed value', so the fine-braking phase started outside its design conditions and Vikram hard-landed within 500 m of the designated site. ISRO cites neither the site nor the date.

sources.label: PIB (Govt. of India), Chandrayaan-2 statement, 20 Nov 2019
PIB (Govt. of India), Chandrayaan-3 statement, 3 Aug 2023

blurb: Lost in final descent near the south pole because of braking performance, not lighting or site choice.
